verdict.rationale: Calendly documents Callie, a beta AI assistant that coordinates scheduling over email. Community reports describe mutual-availability views and group polls that consider everyone's availability. Nothing shows AI ranking or choosing an optimal time across all attendees' calendars, or re-optimizing meetings after booking. Missing for 10: evidence that the AI selects the best slot rather than any open slot, continuous re-optimization or rescheduling to better times, documented cross-attendee calendar analysis by the AI, and independent hands-on corroboration of Callie.

support.subject: As a knowledge worker, AI finds and continuously optimizes the best meeting time across all attendees' calendars, not just the first open slot

citations.quote: Add Callie to any email thread to coordinate scheduling on your behalf without switching tools or sacrificing control.
Callie Beta: An AI assistant that schedules over email

One of the most powerful features we built was the ability to show availability both ways, so if the person booking also has Calendly, they see times where both parties are available, reducing back-and-forth.
zcal is missing the ability to create a meeting 'poll' with all team members including external people that automatically considers everyone's availability
